PrivacyPolicyPage.title: Privacy policy
PrivacyPolicyPage.meta_description: Read iDeal's privacy policy to learn how we collect, use, and protect your personal information.
PrivacyPolicyPage.intro: At iDeal, we respect your privacy and are committed to protecting the personal information you share with us.
PrivacyPolicyPage.draft_body: This privacy policy is currently pending final legal review. Terms may be updated.
PrivacyPolicyPage.data_body: We collect information you provide directly, such as your name, contact details, payment information, and listing preferences.
PrivacyPolicyPage.use_body: We use collected information to provide and improve our rental platform, facilitate transactions, verify identities, and communicate with you.
PrivacyPolicyPage.sharing_body: We do not sell your personal data. We only share information with property owners, tenants, payment processors, and verified service providers as necessary to fulfill agreements.
PrivacyPolicyPage.retention_body: We retain your personal data for as long as needed to provide our services, comply with legal obligations, and resolve disputes.
PrivacyPolicyPage.security_body: We implement appropriate technical and organizational safeguards to protect your personal information against unauthorized access, loss, or misuse.
PrivacyPolicyPage.rights_body: You have the right to access, update, or correct your personal data at any time through your account settings or by contacting our support team.
PrivacyPolicyPage.deletion_body: You can request deletion of your account and associated personal data by submitting a request to our support team.
PrivacyPolicyPage.contact_body: If you have any questions or concerns regarding this privacy policy, please reach out to us at privacy@ideal.uz.

TermsOfServicePage.title: Terms of service
TermsOfServicePage.meta_description: Read the terms that govern your use of the iDeal platform.
TermsOfServicePage.intro: These terms describe the rules for using iDeal's property rental and sale platform.
TermsOfServicePage.draft_body: These terms are currently pending final legal review and may be updated.
TermsOfServicePage.general_body: iDeal provides services for renting and buying real estate. By using the platform, you agree to these terms.
TermsOfServicePage.owners_body: Anyone who publishes a property listing is personally responsible for its accuracy, currency, and lawful ownership.
TermsOfServicePage.bookings_body: Bookings and payments made through the platform are processed through secure payment gateways and documented by the applicable agreement.
TermsOfServicePage.privacy_body: Personal data is protected in accordance with the laws of the Republic of Uzbekistan and is not disclosed to third parties except where needed to provide the service or comply with law.

DeleteAccountPage.title: Request account and data deletion
DeleteAccountPage.meta_description: Request deletion of your iDeal account and associated personal data with OTP verification.
DeleteAccountPage.intro: Submit a request to permanently delete your iDeal account and associated personal data. This action is irreversible.
DeleteAccountPage.deleted_data_body: Your profile details (name, email, phone number, avatar), active login sessions, device push notification tokens, notification preferences, and search/browsing history will be permanently deleted and anonymized.
DeleteAccountPage.retained_data_body: Executed rental agreements, payment transaction history, and official invoices are retained solely to comply with applicable tax, financial, and statutory accounting regulations.
DeleteAccountPage.timeline_body: Upon successful verification of your phone number via OTP, your account is immediately deactivated and personal data anonymization takes place automatically.
